edges.reason: withdraw is gated by onlyOwner on _msgSender() and sends the full balance to msg.sender.
mintCryptoChampions uses msg.sender as the mint recipient and for the per-address balance cap.
transferFrom authorizes _msgSender() through _isApprovedOrOwner.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() into the receiver callback.
Constructor derives REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from the miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
mintCryptoChampions compares block.timestamp with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to set the starting index block.
transferFrom gates transfers on block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
withdraw pushes the entire contract balance to the caller.
setStartingIndex computes the index from a past block hash.
mintCryptoChampions performs SafeMath add/mul on supply and price values.
mintCryptoChampions calls _safeMint which triggers _checkOnERC721Received for contract recipients.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call to the recipient's onERC721Received before state is fully settled for minting flows.
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop count and payment validation.
from identifies the current owner of the transferred token.
to is the transfer destination checked against maxChampionPurchase.
tokenId selects the token being transferred.
revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
newChampionPrice is written into championPrice.
newMaxChampionPurchase is written into maxChampionPurchase.
provenanceHash is written into HOUND_PROVENANCE.
baseURI is written into the ERC721 base URI storage.
_tokenURI is written into the token URI mapping.
tokenId selects the token whose URI is updated.
Local balance is assigned address(this).balance before the transfer.
mintIndex is computed from totalSupply inside the mint loop.
Loop counter i controls the mint iteration.
setProvenanceHash writes the HOUND_PROVENANCE state variable.
setChampionPrice writes championPrice.
mintCryptoChampions reads championPrice for the msg.value payment check.
setMaxChampionPurchase writes maxChampionPurchase.
mintCryptoChampions reads maxChampionPurchase for the mint-count and balance caps.
transferFrom limits the recipient balance using maxChampionPurchase.
mintCryptoChampions checks that total supply stays within MAX_CHAMPIONS.
setStartingIndex uses MAX_CHAMPIONS as the modulo for the index.
Constructor assigns MAX_CHAMPIONS from maxNftSupply.
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
mintCryptoChampions requires saleIsActive to be true.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintCryptoChampions reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in the starting index condition.
transferFrom reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP for its time gate.
Constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to block.timestamp + 7 days.
mintCryptoChampions sets startingIndexBlock once the reveal condition holds.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the seed block.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock.
setStartingIndex requires startingIndex to be zero and then writes it.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to still be zero.
withdraw is restricted to the owner by the onlyOwner modifier.
setRevealTimestamp is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setChampionPrice is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setMaxChampionPurchase is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setProvenanceHash is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setBaseURI is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setTokenURI is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
flipSaleState is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
